title: Table 1.1b Primary garden area provisions: minimum area by site area (single houses R50-R80 and R80-equivalent codes)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Keyed on site area. Site area is rounded up to the nearest whole number, so rows are listed ascending with shared endpoints: an exact boundary (e.g. 130) takes the lower band, anything above it (130.1, rounded up to 131) takes the next. Sites under 100 m2 have no row (NOT_APPLICABLE): R100-SL lots are governed by Table 2.10a (C1.1.3-r100sl). Constants in the rules: 35% maximum permanent roof cover (C1.1.3-r2), 3 m minimum dimension (C1.1.3-r1), behind the street setback area unless C1.1.5 (C1.1.3-r3). Each band is 5 m2 below current Table 1.1a (4 m2 for the 100-130 band).
